mapper.sql: definition_id AS definitionId, definition_code AS definitionCode, definition_name AS definitionName, description, status, current_version_no AS currentVersionNo, draft_version_no AS draftVersionNo, version, created_by AS createdBy, updated_by AS updatedBy, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_workflow_definition (definition_id, definition_code, definition_name, description, status, current_version_no, draft_version_no, version, created_by, updated_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{row.definitionId}, #{row.definitionCode}, #{row.definitionName}, #{row.description}, #{row.status}, #{row.currentVersionNo}, #{row.draftVersionNo}, #{row.version}, #{row.createdBy}, #{row.updatedBy}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_workflow_definition WHERE definition_id IN #{id}

where.if: AND (definition_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR definition_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_workflow_definition ORDER BY update_time DESC, definition_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
